items.headline: Apollo Sees Huge Europe Finance Demand for AI, Defense
items.excerpt: Apollo sees a major opportunity to provide long-term capital in Europe, where fragmented markets are fueling direct lending growth. The firm, which is launching a €10 billion regional private-credit arm, is particularly focused on financing defense supply chains as Europe’s investment needs rise.
